about.title: How it works
about.body:
About us

Childcare you can trust

Nanny-App connects families with vetted, caring nannies — and gives nannies a simple way to find work they love. We handle the searching, booking and moderation so everyone can focus on what matters: happy, well-cared-for children.

🛡️

Trust first

Every nanny is reviewed and verified by our admin team before they appear in search results.

💙

Built on care

From newborn specialists to playful all-rounders, we help you find the right match for your family.

⚡

Refreshingly simple

Search, request a booking and track everything in one place — on your phone or computer.

Our story

NannyApp is a South African childcare booking platform that puts safety and simplicity first. Parents browse verified nannies, send booking requests and see an estimated cost up front. Nannies manage their own profile, rates and availability, and accept or decline requests on their terms. An admin team moderates the platform and verifies every nanny.

We believe finding childcare shouldn't be stressful — so we made it feel as warm and reassuring as the care itself.

safety.title: Safety
safety.body:
Safety & trust

How we help keep families safe

Safety is the foundation of Nanny-App. Here's how we protect parents, nannies and children at every step.

✅

Verified nannies

Only nannies approved by our admin team appear in search. Editing a profile sends it back for re-verification.

👀

Human moderation

Admins review accounts and can suspend or remove anyone who breaks our community standards.

🔒

Secure by design

Passwords are hashed, every form is protected against cross-site request forgery, and access is role-based.

💳

Transparent costs

See an estimated cost before you request a booking — no hidden fees or surprises.

📝

Booking records

Every request, confirmation and completed session is logged to your dashboard for full transparency.

🚩

Report concerns

Something not right? Contact us and our team will look into it quickly.

Safety tips for parents

Read each nanny's profile, experience and skills carefully before booking.

Use the notes field to share your children's ages and any special needs.

Meet your nanny and agree on expectations before the first session.

Keep all communication and bookings on the platform so there's a clear record.

Pricing

Simple, honest pricing

No subscriptions, no hidden fees. Browse for free and only pay for the care you book.

Pay As You Go

Book by the hour

Messaging & reviews

For families who book childcare regularly.

Reduced service fees

Priority support

Premium

Full peace of mind with concierge support.

R399/mo

Everything in Family

Dedicated care coordinator

Last-minute bookings

Background-check reports

24/7 phone support

Common pricing questions

Is there a monthly fee?

Creating an account is completely free for parents and nannies. You only pay the nanny's hourly rate when you book.

How is the total cost calculated?

Cost = the nanny's hourly rate × the number of hours booked. You see the full estimate before confirming — no surprises.

Can nannies set their own rate?

Yes. Every nanny sets and can update their hourly rate any time from their profile page.

What payment methods are accepted?

We accept all major South African debit and credit cards via Paystack. EFT options are also available for qualifying bookings.

What is the refund policy?

Cancellations made more than 24 hours before a booking receive a full refund. Late cancellations may incur a fee. Contact support for disputes.

faq.title: Help centre
faq.body:
Help centre

Frequently asked questions

Find answers to the most common questions about Nanny-App.

How do I book a nanny?

Create a free account, browse verified nannies near you, then click "Book Now". Our 5-step booking wizard guides you through choosing the date, time, address, children details and completing payment securely.

How do payments work?

Online card payments are not available during our launch phase. After a nanny confirms your booking, our team provides approved manual payment instructions. Received payments are recorded and held until the session is completed.

How do I become a nanny?

Register and choose the "Nanny" role. Complete your profile with your bio, experience, qualifications and ID. Our team reviews and verifies applications within 1–3 business days. Once verified, you appear in parent search results.

Can I cancel or reschedule a booking?

Yes. Cancel or reschedule from your Bookings page. Cancellations made more than 24 hours before the booking receive a full refund. Late cancellations may incur a small fee depending on the nanny's policy.

How are nannies verified?

Every nanny completes identity verification, a criminal background check, reference checks and a qualifications review. Our admin team manually reviews all documentation before awarding the Verified badge.

How do I contact support?

Submit a ticket via our Support page, email us, or use the contact form. Our team responds within 24 hours on business days. For urgent safety concerns, use the Emergency button in your dashboard.

What languages do nannies speak?

Our nannies speak a variety of South African languages including English, isiZulu, Sesotho, and Afrikaans. Use the language filter on the search page to find nannies who speak your preferred language.

What if there is a problem during a booking?

Contact support immediately via the Support page or the in-app emergency button. We investigate all disputes fairly and can issue refunds or take action against any party who violates our community standards.

Is my personal information safe?

Yes. We use industry-standard encryption, secure sessions, and we never share your personal information with third parties without your consent. Passwords are hashed using bcrypt.

How do I leave a review?

After a booking is marked as completed, you will receive a notification inviting you to rate your nanny out of 5 stars and leave a comment. Reviews appear publicly on the nanny's profile.

Still have a question?

Our support team is here to help — we respond within 24 hours.

Community

Families and nannies, together

Nanny-App is more than a booking platform — it's a growing community built on trust, care and professional childcare across South Africa.

Our values

resources.body:
Resources

Guides for parents & nannies

Practical childcare tips, safety guides and expert advice to help your family thrive.

For parents

Find care with confidence

Hiring

First aid certification, discipline philosophy, references and experience — the essential questions that protect your family.

Relationships

Building trust with your nanny

How to establish a positive, trusting relationship between your family and your nanny from day one.

Scheduling

Build a schedule that works

Create a balanced schedule that meets your family's needs while respecting your nanny's time and boundaries.

Safety

Child safety essentials

Emergency contacts, allergy information, home safety and what to brief your nanny before every session.

Child development

Age-appropriate activities

Fun, educational activities for newborns, toddlers, school-age children and teenagers that nannies can use.

Communication

Giving feedback to your nanny

How to give constructive, respectful feedback that improves care quality and keeps the relationship strong.

For nannies

Build a successful career

👤

Building a great profile

A warm bio, clear skills list, professional photo and honest rate help families choose you with confidence.

✅

Getting verified

Upload your ID, qualifications and certificates to our secure portal. Admin verification typically takes 1–3 business days.

📋

Managing bookings

Respond to requests promptly, confirm details and mark sessions complete to maintain a strong track record.

⭐

Earning great reviews

Punctuality, clear communication and going the extra mile earn 5-star reviews that attract more families.

💰

Setting your rate

Research market rates for your area, experience level and specialisations. You can update your rate any time.

🗓️

Managing availability

Keep your availability calendar up to date so parents can see when you're free and book with confidence.

Free 24/7 child helpline

Private emergency response

Anonymous crime reporting

Child development

Key milestones by age

0–12 months

👶 Newborn & infant

Eye contact by 6 weeks, social smiling by 2 months, sitting independently by 6–8 months, first words around 12 months. Nannies should track and record developmental milestones for parents.

1–3 years

🚶 Toddler

Walking, climbing, 2-word phrases at 2 years, toilet training from 18–24 months, imaginative play begins. Structured routine and consistent caregivers are critical at this stage.

3–5 years

🎨 Pre-school

Sentences of 4–5 words, drawing basic shapes, dressing independently, beginning to share and cooperate. Creative play and reading aloud make a big difference.

5–8 years

📚 Early school

Reading begins, more complex social interactions, understanding rules and fairness. Homework help and after-school structure are valuable at this age.

8–12 years

⚽ Middle childhood

Strong friendships, logical thinking, hobbies develop. Nannies can support transport to activities, homework, and emotional regulation.

12+ years

💬 Adolescence

Increasing independence and privacy. A trusted older presence still matters — especially for after-school supervision and emotional support.

🥗 Healthy meal ideas for nannies

Quick, nutritious meals and snacks that nannies can prepare with everyday kitchen ingredients.

Toddlers (1–3)

Soft fruit pieces · Cheese cubes · Peanut butter on rice cakes · Yoghurt with berries · Steamed veg with hummus

School age (4–10)

Avo and egg on toast · Mini wraps with cheese · Fruit smoothies · Baked sweet potato · Brown rice with chicken

Teens

Pasta with tomato sauce · Stir-fried veg with noodles · Oats with banana · Boiled eggs and whole-wheat toast · Soup with bread

Quick answers

Frequently asked questions

How does NannyApp verify nannies?

Every nanny goes through a manual ID check, qualification review, and background screening by our admin team before receiving the Verified badge. This typically takes 1–3 business days.

Can I cancel a booking?

Yes. Cancel at least 24 hours before the session start time for a full refund. Late cancellations may incur a cancellation fee. Contact support if you have exceptional circumstances.

What payment methods are accepted?

We accept all major debit and credit cards through our secure payment gateway. Funds are held and released to the nanny only after the session is completed.

How are nanny rates set?

Nannies set their own hourly rates based on their experience, qualifications, and location. You can filter search results by rate range to find the right fit for your budget.

What if I have a problem during a session?

Contact your nanny directly via the in-app message system. For emergencies, call the relevant South African emergency number. For platform issues, open a support ticket or call our support line.

Is NannyApp available outside Johannesburg?

Yes. We currently have active nannies in Johannesburg, Sandton, Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand, Cape Town, Durban, and growing. More areas are added as we verify nannies in new regions.

Ready to get started?

Create your free account and join the Nanny-App community today.

terms.title: Terms
terms.body:
Legal

Terms of Service

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the NannyApp platform operated by NannyApp (Pty) Ltd ("NannyApp", "we", "us"). By creating an account or using any part of the platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use NannyApp.

1. The NannyApp Platform

NannyApp is an online marketplace that connects parents and guardians ("Parents") with childcare providers ("Nannies"). NannyApp is a facilitator — we are not an employer of Nannies, nor are we a party to the individual childcare arrangements made through the platform.

2. Eligibility and Account Registration

You must be at least 18 years old to create an account.

You must provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration and keep it updated.

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your password and for all activity that occurs under your account.

You may not create more than one account per person without our written permission.

Accounts are non-transferable.

3. User Roles and Responsibilities

3.1 Parents

Parents are responsible for accurately describing their childcare needs, including any relevant medical information about children in their care.

Parents must treat Nannies with respect and maintain a safe home environment.

Parents are responsible for payment of all bookings made through the platform.

Parents agree to leave only honest, accurate reviews of Nannies.

3.2 Nannies

Nannies must accurately represent their qualifications, experience, availability, and skills.

Nannies must hold any certifications they claim (e.g. First Aid) and keep them current.

Nannies agree to undergo the NannyApp identity and background verification process and to provide truthful documentation.

Nannies are responsible for their own tax obligations arising from income earned through the platform.

Nannies agree to arrive on time, perform the agreed childcare duties professionally, and communicate promptly with Parents.

4. Booking and Cancellations

Bookings are confirmed only after the Nanny accepts the request.

Cancellations by the Parent must be made at least 24 hours before the scheduled start time to avoid a cancellation fee.

Nannies who repeatedly cancel confirmed bookings may have their accounts reviewed or suspended.

NannyApp reserves the right to cancel or modify bookings in exceptional circumstances, including safety concerns or platform violations.

5. Payments

Online card payments are not available during the launch phase. Payment instructions are provided after the Nanny accepts a booking.

Payments confirmed by our operations team are recorded as held and may only be released to the Nanny after completion of the session, or resolved by an administrator in a dispute.

Refunds are assessed against the booking record and the applicable cancellation policy. Contact support promptly if there is a dispute.

6. Verification

NannyApp takes reasonable steps to verify Nanny identities and backgrounds but cannot guarantee the accuracy of all information provided by users. Parents are encouraged to conduct their own due diligence. NannyApp's verification badge indicates that a Nanny has passed our standard checks at the time of verification — it is not a guarantee of future conduct.

7. Prohibited Conduct

You may not:

Provide false, misleading, or fraudulent information on your profile or in bookings.

Use the platform for any unlawful purpose or in violation of any applicable law.

Harass, abuse, or threaten other users.

privacy.body:
Legal

Privacy Policy

NannyApp (Pty) Ltd ("we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of every person who uses our platform. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding that information.

By registering for or using NannyApp you agree to the collection and use of information as described in this policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

1. Information We Collect

1.1 Information you provide directly

Account information: full name, email address, password (stored as a bcrypt hash), phone number, and profile photograph.

Parent profile: home address, children's names, ages, allergies, and any medical or special-needs notes you choose to share.

Nanny profile: bio, location, hourly rate, skills, languages spoken, qualifications, identification documents, and certification photographs.

Booking details: booking dates, times, duration, address, and notes about the session.

Messages: content of in-app conversations between parents and nannies.

Reviews: star ratings and written feedback you submit after a completed session.

Payment information: transaction references and amounts. We do not store full card numbers — payments are processed by a secure third-party provider.

Support requests: the content of tickets you submit through our support system.

1.2 Information collected automatically

IP address and approximate location.

Browser type, device type, and operating system.

Pages visited, time on page, and referral source (collected via server logs).

Session cookies and a 30-day "remember me" cookie if you enable that option at login.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your personal information to:

Create and manage your account and verify your identity.

Match parents with suitable nannies based on location, skills, and availability.

Process and manage bookings and payments.

Send booking confirmations, reminders, and status updates.

Enable in-app messaging between parents and nannies.

Verify nanny identities and conduct background checks.

Display your profile to other users as appropriate to your role.

Improve the platform through aggregated, anonymised analytics.

Respond to your support tickets and enquiries.

Send platform-related notifications (you may opt out of non-essential notifications in your account settings).

Comply with legal obligations, including the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) and the Electronic Communications and Transactions Act (ECTA).

3. Sharing Your Information

We share your information only as follows:

Between parents and nannies: when a booking is created, the relevant parent and nanny can see each other's name, profile photograph, and contact details necessary to carry out the booking.

Payment records: during the manual-payment launch phase, we record payment status and references needed to manage bookings and payouts.

Background check providers: nanny identity and document information is shared with our verification partners for the purpose of conducting background checks.

Legal requirements: we may disclose information if required by South African law, court order, or to protect the safety of our users.

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

4. Data Retention

We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active and for a reasonable period afterwards in case you choose to return. Booking records, payment history, and reviews are retained for a minimum of three years for business and legal purposes. You may request deletion of your account at any time (see Section 7).

5. Security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data, including:

Passwords hashed with bcrypt (never stored in plain text).

All SQL queries use parameterised statements to prevent injection attacks.

CSRF tokens on all forms.

HTTP-only session cookies.

Restricted direct access to configuration and database files via server rules.

No system is completely secure. If you believe your account has been compromised, please contact us immediately at privacy@nanny-app.co.za.

6. Cookies

We use the following cookies:

Session cookie: required for login and CSRF protection. Expires when you close your browser (or after your session timeout).

Remember-me cookie (na_remember): optional, 30-day persistent cookie set only if you check "Remember me" at login.

We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies.

7. Your Rights under POPIA

As a South African data subject you have the right to:

Access: request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.

Correction: ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete information.

Deletion: request that we delete your account and associated personal data (subject to retention obligations).

Objection: object to the processing of your data in certain circumstances.

Complaint: lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator of South Africa if you believe we have breached POPIA.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at privacy@nanny-app.co.za or submit a request through our support system. We will respond within 30 days.

8. Children's Privacy

Children's profiles (names, ages, and care notes) are entered by parents or guardians. This information is used solely to facilitate the childcare service and is visible only to the specific nanny assigned to a booking. We do not process children's data for any other purpose.

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by email or by a prominent notice on the platform at least 14 days before the change takes effect. Continued use of NannyApp after that date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

10. Contact Us

For any privacy-related questions, access requests, or concerns, please contact our Information Officer:

NannyApp (Pty) Ltd
Email: privacy@nanny-app.co.za
Tel: +27 10 000 0000
Physical address: Sandton, Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa
